changes.after: Where do FlatMapDeserializer's forwarded bool, string, byte-buffer and sequence methods produce the can-only-flatten-structs-and-maps diagnostic?

changes.after: Within deserialize_in_place_body, which representation and shape checks suppress a method when the feature is enabled, and what is returned without that feature?

changes.after: When requested, allow one identifier mode only on enum data

limitations: This receipt accepts the full 150-row public DEV source/gold packet; native freeze/validate and retrieval execution require their own receipts.

Native file/span gold and source call sites do not certify runtime behavior or exact ordered graph-path correctness.
No untouched holdout body was accessed; no historic v19 or original 301 DEV record was changed by this review.
Author pending annotations remain immutable authoring history; acceptance is provided by this non-author exact-byte receipt.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: Two required groups distinguish next_element from next_entry; both recursively discard values using IgnoredAny; byte visitor is a different input kind.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: The Deserialize implementation delegates directly to deserialize_ignored_any; visit_none is only a visitor callback.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: The helper caps bytes at 1024*1024 divided by element size and returns zero for a zero-sized element; bounds equality does not impose that cap.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: from_bounds invokes helper(iter.size_hint()); helper returns Some only for equal lower and present upper bounds; cautious does not certify length.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: apply_to_variant inserts an underscore before noninitial uppercase characters and lowercases; field-oriented conversion is correctly excluded.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: apply_to_field tracks underscore boundaries and delegates camelCase to the PascalCase result; variant conversion performs a different transformation.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: from_str creates ParseError for a missing rule; the Display fmt code prints unknown and enumerates RENAME_RULES; or is a non-parsing combiner.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: check_flatten_field emits distinct tuple and newtype diagnostics after checking flatten; getter validation is unrelated.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: check_transparent enforces one selected eligible field; allow_transparent excludes PhantomData and derive-specific skipped/default fields; conversion-conflict check does not select a field.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: Only internally tagged enum struct variants are checked; skipped directions and untagged variants are accounted for; serialized names and deserialization aliases are compared.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: The adjacent representation matcher compares type tag and content key and rejects equality; internal field collisions are distinct.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: TagType::Internal dispatches to enum_internally::deserialize, whose generated code uses TaggedContentVisitor and then ContentDeserializer; this is source-call-site evidence, not an evaluated graph-path score.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: The enum dispatcher splits trailing untagged variants and passes a first_attempt that returns on tagged success and falls through on error; the homogeneous matcher cannot establish this ordering alone.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: The untagged generator buffers once, retries non-skipped variants by reference and emits a no-match diagnostic; the internal-tag generator selects by tag instead.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: Both proc-macro entry functions parse DeriveInput and map expansion errors through syn::Error::into_compile_error; private identifier generation is not an entry point.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: Formatter declares all compound associated states Impossible; serialize_seq returns Err; the empty Void field makes safe construction impossible. Unit variants use Display and are correctly a distractor.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: The hard scope excludes the actual de/ignored_any.rs visitor. Independently searched the entire serde_core/src/ser subtree for IgnoredAny and fn visit_map: no matches (rg exit 1), and all admitted scoped files were inventoried. Related positive and negative share family f0004.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: invalid_type and invalid_value format the two distinct diagnostics directly; invalid_length reports a separate dimension.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: unknown_variant branches on expected.is_empty and emits the no-variants diagnostic; unknown_field is analogous but concerns a different domain.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: The default Deserialize::deserialize_in_place deserializes a replacement before assignment; InPlaceSeed merely calls the selected type implementation.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: DeserializeOwned has the requested for<'de> bound and identical blanket implementation; DeserializeSeed is stateful and does not impose ownership.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: PhantomData implements DeserializeSeed with Value=T and delegates to T::deserialize; the in-place seed instead writes to place and returns unit.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: SeqAccess::next_element supplies PhantomData to next_element_seed; MapAccess::next_entry supplies two seeds for a different protocol.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: The default next_entry_seed requests the key first, returns None on exhaustion, then invokes the value seed with error propagation; the serializer counterpart writes values.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: visit_u32 widens with v as u64 and invokes visit_u64; the default u64 callback returns invalid_type(Unexpected::Unsigned), while f32 widening targets f64.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: The default visit_char directly calls encode_utf8 with a four-byte temporary and then visit_str; CharVisitor validates or accepts char input instead of defining this forwarding.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: Default borrowed and owned string callbacks both use visit_str, borrowing the owned String temporarily; the dedicated StrVisitor returns the input borrow directly.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: visit_i128 formats the full value into the explicit 58-byte buffer and uses Unexpected::Other; visit_i64 uses Unexpected::Signed and has no such formatting step.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: collect_seq obtains iterator_len_hint, writes each item through serialize_element, and calls end; the helper returns Some only for equal bounds. This is source-call evidence, not runtime graph-path certification.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: collect_map iterates key-value pairs, obtains a map state, calls serialize_entry and end; collect_seq sends sequence elements and is a valid related distractor.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: SerializeMap::serialize_entry uses tri! around serialize_key before calling serialize_value; the input-side seeded protocol does not implement the output operation.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: Formatter::collect_str calls Display::fmt directly; the allocation-enabled trait default calls to_string then serialize_str. The related newtype method dispatches Serialize instead.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: BorrowedStrDeserializer ties its stored reference to 'de and calls visit_borrowed_str; StrDeserializer permits an independent 'a and calls visit_str. The downstream Visitor default cannot create that lifetime guarantee.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: SeqDeserializer checks exhaustion after visit_seq and reports consumed plus remaining elements against ExpectedInSeq(count); the analogous map end method is a separate container protocol.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: MapDeserializer stores value=Some(value) while handing out its key, then next_value_seed takes it and panics with an explicit protocol-error message if absent; the combined-entry method bypasses the pending slot.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: Ctxt::check consumes the Option of errors and combines syn errors; Drop panics only when an unchecked context remains and the thread is not already panicking. syn_error only appends.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: Attr::set diagnoses a duplicate while preserving the previously stored value; VecAttr::insert deliberately appends and records first duplicate tokens for later checks.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: OptionVisitor maps unit and none to None, but visit_some propagates T deserialization and maps Some. The private untagged hook deliberately converts failed T deserialization into None.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: CharVisitor consumes two chars and accepts only (Some(c), None); empty and multi-scalar strings take invalid_value. The trait default forwards an already valid char in the opposite direction.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: StringVisitor reuses an owned String, copies a valid borrowed str, and validates UTF-8 for bytes and byte buffers; BytesVisitor returns raw borrowed bytes without that validation.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: StringInPlaceVisitor clears and appends a borrowed str but replaces the target with an owned String. The ordinary StringVisitor allocates an owned result instead.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: StrVisitor returns the borrowed str directly and converts borrowed bytes through str::from_utf8 while preserving the borrow; StringVisitor returns owned storage.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: BytesVisitor returns borrowed bytes directly or uses as_bytes on a borrowed str, whereas StrVisitor requires valid UTF-8 and returns text.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: CString sequence visitation uses cautious u8 capacity, consumes all values, and maps CString::new failure through Error::custom; the byte-buffer callback does not manage sequence preallocation.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: The Vec visitor bounds only initial capacity using cautious<T>, then loops until next_element returns None. The helper alone neither consumes nor truncates input.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: The in-place Vec visitor reserves extra capacity, deserializes into existing elements with InPlaceSeed, truncates at the first exhausted element, then pushes any remaining values. The new-Vec visitor cannot reuse existing elements.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: Generic Cow deserialization invokes T::Owned::deserialize and maps Cow::Owned; the separately generated borrow_cow_str helper has an actual borrow-preserving visitor.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: Both RcWeak and ArcWeak consume Option<T> and then return Weak::new, discarding the payload rather than retaining a strong reference. Cow retains its owned payload and is a different mechanism.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: int_to_int uses TryFrom and invalid_value for ordinary conversions, while its Saturating arm explicitly clamps below MIN or above MAX; num_as_self performs direct casts and does not implement this check.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: int_to_uint checks nonnegative ordinary input before TryFrom, and its Saturating arm clamps negative values to zero and excessive values to MAX; uint_to_self cannot receive a negative source value.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: The matching-type NonZero num_self arm calls new(v) and produces invalid_value when zero fails; the Saturating arm directly wraps zero as a valid value.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: num_as_copysign_self captures is_sign_positive before the numeric cast and applies copysign under std; the no_std and plain-cast arms omit that explicit sign restoration.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: RefCell serialization uses try_borrow and returns the exact already-mutably-borrowed serializer error, avoiding the panicking borrow API; Cell instead copies with get.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: Mutex serialization calls lock and RwLock serialization calls read; both convert poisoning to the same serializer error. RefCell borrow failures are distinct.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: Result serialization emits named newtype variants Ok at index 0 and Err at index 1, representing data rather than the serializer operation result; Option uses none/some calls instead.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: Duration serialization opens a two-field struct, writes secs and nanos and calls end; SystemTime uses an epoch offset with different names and validation.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: SystemTime first checks duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH), returns an error for earlier values, and serializes secs_since_epoch/nanos_since_epoch otherwise. Duration contains no epoch check.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: IpAddr delegates to the concrete readable address serializer, while compact mode explicitly emits V4 and V6 newtype variants with indices 0 and 1. SocketAddr uses analogous endpoint tags with ports.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: Readable Ipv4Addr constructs its dotted ASCII form in a 15-byte stack buffer and calls serialize_str; format_u8 writes one, two or three digits. Ipv6Addr uses a separate bounded Display formatter.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: SocketAddrV6 sets MAX_LEN=58 for its readable Display path and serializes only (ip, port) in compact mode. A bare IPv6 address has neither socket port nor this larger bound.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: Path requires to_str success and errors for invalid UTF-8; PathBuf delegates through as_path. OsStr emits platform-native bytes or wide characters and is a different representation policy.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: The Unix OsStr branch emits OsString/Unix with as_bytes, while the Windows branch collects encode_wide u16 units and emits OsString/Windows. This is an OS encoding question, accurately categorized as semantic_feature rather than mixed-language evidence.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: Duration map visitation rejects duplicates and missing secs/nanos, calls check_overflow and constructs Duration; the helper checks seconds plus nanos/billion. Serialization assumes a valid existing Duration. This reverse-direction variant explicitly shares family f0059.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: The epoch-offset helper checks nanosecond carry for overflow, and the final caller uses UNIX_EPOCH.checked_add with its own error. This SystemTime reverse-direction variant explicitly shares family f0060.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: Range and RangeInclusive both pass range::RangeVisitor and range::FIELDS but construct start..end and RangeInclusive::new respectively. Bound represents one endpoint condition with enum variants and is a valid distractor.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: PathVisitor preserves a borrowed path from borrowed str or UTF-8-validated borrowed bytes; PathBufVisitor constructs owned storage. OsStringVisitor instead validates platform tags. The path behavior variant shares family f0064.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: OsStringVisitor conditionally accepts Unix from_vec or Windows from_wide and emits an explicit error for the opposite platform; the serializer only writes the local representation. This shares family f0065 with its encoding direction.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: BoundVisitor dispatches Unbounded through unit_variant and Included/Excluded through newtype_variant. Result uses only two payload-bearing newtype variants.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: The Result FieldVisitor accepts numeric 0/1 and Ok/Err names, reports unknown_variant for unknown valid UTF-8 and invalid_value for malformed bytes. Payload visitation happens after recognition; this reverse-direction variant shares f0058.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: The serialization atomic_impl macro performs Relaxed loads before ordinary serialization; the deserialization macro maps primitive Deserialize to Self::new. No synchronization guarantee is inferred from this source evidence.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: FromStrVisitor renders self.expecting and calls s.parse().map_err(Error::custom) under FromStr plus Display bounds; StringVisitor does not parse a target type.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: The private MissingFieldDeserializer overrides deserialize_option with visit_none and forwards all other listed requests to missing_field failure. The public missing_field constructor alone cannot implement this Option exception.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: borrow_cow_str returns Borrowed only from borrowed str or validated borrowed bytes; transient str/bytes and owned String/buffer produce owned storage. It shares the generic Cow family f0050.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: borrow_cow_bytes preserves borrowed byte/string slices, copies transient slices and consumes owned String with into_bytes or an owned byte buffer. It shares Cow family f0050; text conversion imposes a different UTF-8 requirement.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: FlatMapAccess borrows buffered entries without taking them; FlatStructAccess invokes flat_map_take_entry, which takes only an entry with a recognized string key. This preserves data for later flattened fields.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: The final query explicitly selects forwarded bool, string, byte-buffer and sequence methods, all present in forward_to_deserialize_other and all routed to the stated restriction error. The broader v1 scalar wording was narrowed because i128/u128 are absent from this forwarding list and retain distinct trait defaults; unit is accepted separately.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: FlatMapDeserializer iterates buffered entries, consumes the first recognized variant key and invokes EnumDeserializer, then emits a named no-variant error if exhausted. It shares the flattened-input family f0078.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: FlatMapDeserializer delegates option handling to __private_visit_untagged_option; OptionVisitor returns Ok(T::deserialize(...).ok()), while ordinary visit_some propagates inner failure. This shares Option family f0041.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: serialize_tagged_newtype wraps the delegate in TaggedSerializer; map length is incremented only when known and a tag entry is written first, while struct length always increases by one and the tag field is written first.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: FlatMapSerializer emits no entry for none/unit/unit-struct, recursively serializes Some and newtype payloads through itself, and separately writes a unit-variant name as an entry. Overlapping evidence for Some is explicit rather than a second independent proof.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: FlatMapSerializeMap forwards keys, values and entries and makes end return Ok(()); FlatMapSerializeStruct turns fields into map entries and also has a no-op end. Both preserve completion for the enclosing map and share family f0083.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: Tuple default ordering validation runs only without a container default, ignores skipped deserialization fields, remembers the first default and rejects subsequent required fields. Flatten validation is unrelated.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: check_getter rejects enum getters and permits struct getters only for remote containers; check_remote_generic controls generic path syntax instead.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: check_remote_generic detects both local generic parameters and arguments on the final remote path segment, then asks to remove path parameters; getters do not determine this condition.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: check_identifier rejects other on variant identifiers and untagged enums, requires unit shape and final position, and handles identifier catch-all variants separately. Custom serializer/skip rules are unrelated.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: check_variant_skip_attrs tests serialize_with against variant skip, field skip and skip_if, and deserialize_with against variant or field deserialization skips. Tuple default ordering is a different rule.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: check_from_and_try_from explicitly rejects simultaneous type_from and type_try_from options; remote generic validation has no conversion-attribute role.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: Container::from_ast handles raw syn enum/struct data but emits the explicit unions-unsupported error and returns None for syn::Data::Union, before later container validation.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: Enum fields combine variant rename_all_rules with container rename_all_fields_rules; RenameAllRules::or applies fallback independently for serialize and deserialize. Applying a case transformation does not choose its attribute source.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: enum_from_ast finds the last tagged variant and rejects any individually untagged variant before it; the generator subsequently splits tagged and trailing untagged alternatives. This shares mixed-enum family f0016.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: without_defaults clones all generic metadata and clears default only on type parameters; other parameter variants are cloned unchanged. Appending where predicates performs another operation.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: The bound walker exits immediately for a path ending in PhantomData, before recording type parameters or visiting arguments, because the serialization traits do not require its T bound.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: precondition_sized looks at the final struct field after ungroup and diagnoses syn::Type::Slice; lifetime collision validation does not inspect sizing.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: precondition_no_de_lifetime checks for a user parameter named de only when borrowed_lifetimes returns the Borrowed variant. The separate sizing check cannot establish this condition.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: borrowed_lifetimes unions borrows from fields not skipped for deserialization and gives any static borrow dominance; type-bound eligibility has additional distinct exclusions. This shares lifetime family f0097.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: needs_deserialize_bound excludes field skip/custom deserialize/explicit bound and applies analogous conditions to the optional variant; borrowed-lifetime collection does not enforce all these type-bound rules.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: deserialize_from maps intermediate Deserialize through From::from; deserialize_try_from uses and_then and converts TryFrom errors through de::Error::custom. This shares conversion family f0090.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: The final question is limited to deserialize_in_place_body. Its feature-enabled branch excludes transparent/from/try_from/identifier/all-custom and enum/unit shapes, and the disabled implementation returns None. Caller-level remote exclusion is not represented as part of this gold scope.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: expr_is_missing first chooses a field default or path, then a container default member, then an optional-aware private missing_field helper unless custom deserialization demands a direct missing_field error. This shares missing-field family f0075.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: expr_is_missing_seq chooses field or container defaults before generating invalid_length(index, expecting); named-field missing handling does not use this sequence-index diagnostic. This shares f0075.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: serialize_struct selects map representation if any field is both flatten and not skipped for serialization; otherwise it selects SerializeStruct. Tag-field generation does not choose that representation.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: serialize_struct_as_struct excludes unconditional skips, counts each conditional skip expression, starts from tag presence, and passes the result to serialize_struct before writing and ending. The flattened map uses unknown length. This shares struct-output family f0104.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: serialize_struct_visitor ignores skipped fields, computes the original skip predicate, applies custom serialize_with wrapping, routes flatten through FlatMapSerializer or an ordinary field write, and conditionally emits skip_field where supported. This shares f0104.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: get_member uses a temporary expression before borrowing packed fields and constrains remote direct fields/getter results to the declared field type via an identity-reference helper; local getters are unreachable after validation. This shares getter family f0086.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: effective_style changes only a Newtype variant whose sole field skips serialization to Unit; AST classification itself is based on source field shape and does not account for this output override.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: Remote derive branches emit inherent methods on the local definition: serialization takes a reference to the remote type and deserialization returns it. Ordinary branches emit trait impls; deserialize_in_place is only inserted in that nonremote branch.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: wrap_in_const creates an anonymous const with either a custom path alias or extern crate serde alias, invokes the require-serde-not-serde-core macro and inserts generated code; the private identifier helper has another role.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: this_type removes colon2_token from remote angle-bracketed arguments, while this_value inserts it if missing using the less-than token span. Remote generic validity checking does not perform syntax normalization.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: Name equality and ordering use value alone, whereas ToTokens emits LitStr with the stored span. Display produces text but neither defines equality nor preserves token source location.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: parse_lit_into_lifetimes parses plus-separated lifetimes into a set, records duplicates and empty input, and records malformed syntax with an empty-set return. Where-predicate parsing uses comma-separated syntax instead.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: is_implicitly_borrowed combines direct reference recognition and Option with one matching type argument; its reference matcher delegates to str and u8-slice checks. Cow has a separate two-argument heuristic shape.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: is_cow is explicitly documented as heuristic, with alias false negatives and shadowed str false positives; it checks the last Cow segment and lifetime-plus-type arguments without resolving identity. This shares Cow family f0050.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: decide_tag selects external, untagged, internal or adjacent from the attribute tuple and records conflicts and invalid internal tuple variants. The adjacent tag/content-name collision check is a later, narrower validation.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: decide_identifier permits neither mode, accepts one requested mode only for enum data and reports both-present or non-enum requests. The final facet explicitly says When requested, preserving the legal None/None case.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: Field::rename_by_rules respects explicit per-direction names and inserts the resulting deserialize name into aliases; the case converter itself lacks those flags and alias storage. This shares rename-rule family f0092.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: Serialization generic construction appends field/variant predicates then uses explicit container bounds instead of inference; needs_serialize_bound suppresses automatic bounds for skips, custom serialization and explicit per-field/variant bounds. This shares f0099.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: parse_lit_into_where uses comma-terminated WherePredicate parsing, records syn errors in Ctxt and returns an empty vector on failure; Ctxt::check later preserves those errors. Borrow-list grammar is distinct.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: Buf::write_str checks available capacity before copying or advancing offset, and as_str exposes only the written prefix. Allocation size-hint bounding does not guard each formatting write.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: With std/alloc, private from_utf8_lossy delegates to String::from_utf8_lossy and returns Cow; without either it accepts valid UTF-8 or emits exactly three replacement characters. Borrowed-string deserialization rejects invalid bytes instead.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: The fallback Error trait requires Debug and Display and defaults source to None; a deserialization error constructor consumes an Error interface instead of defining it.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: serde_core exports the exact compile_error requirement macro and the derive anonymous-const wrapper invokes it through the selected _serde alias. This shares wrapper family f0110.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: serde_core/build.rs emits no_core_net below minor 77, no_diagnostic_namespace below 78 and no_core_error below 81; rustc_minor_version invokes RUSTC --version and parses a rustc 1.x string. The facade does not emit all three core decisions.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: The facade PRIVATE template exports its private module and aliases matching serde_core private symbols; the build script substitutes the package patch version and writes private.rs into OUT_DIR. The core template lacks that cross-crate alias.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: Facade alloc forwards to serde_core/alloc, and core alloc is independently declared with allocation/collection support comments. std is a larger separate feature. The final language toml accurately describes both gold manifests.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: The never-active cfg(any()) target dependency pins serde_derive to =1.0.229 and explicitly explains resolver lockstep for nonpublic generated APIs. The derive proc-macro feature declaration does not establish that coupling.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: UnitDeserializer forwards ordinary listed requests to visit_unit but handles option with visit_none. MissingFieldDeserializer errors on ordinary requests and therefore implements a different policy.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: MapAccessDeserializer reads a variant key and rejects empty maps, then returns MapAsEnum to read unit/newtype/tuple/struct payloads through map values. U32Deserializer returns UnitOnly and cannot supply a map payload.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: PairDeserializer permits only requested tuple length two, then requires its second slot to have been consumed after visitation or reports invalid_length(2, consumed). The PairVisitor protocol makes second-slot exhaustion imply both elements consumed; generic SeqDeserializer has no fixed pair shape.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: BorrowedBytesDeserializer ties its reference to de and invokes visit_borrowed_bytes; BytesDeserializer allows an independent input lifetime and invokes visit_bytes. This shares borrowed-adapter family f0036.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: U32Deserializer returns UnitOnly after variant-seed deserialization, and UnitOnly accepts unit_variant while returning shape-specific invalid_type errors for newtype, tuple or struct payloads. MapAsEnum has actual payload storage.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: SeqAccessDeserializer passes its stored SeqAccess directly to visit_seq and forwards other listed requests through deserialize_any. SeqDeserializer owns an iterator and performs a distinct post-visit exhaustion check.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: EnumAccessDeserializer passes the stored access object directly to visit_enum; MapAccessDeserializer must interpret map access as an enum through a separate route. These access-wrapper variants share family f0134.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: The core Serializer and Deserializer is_human_readable defaults both return true; IpAddr merely consults this preference and does not define it.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: Serializer::serialize_i128 and serialize_u128 discard the value and return explicit unsupported custom errors; the input-side Visitor formatting error is a separate path.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: SerializeStruct::skip_field ignores its key and returns Ok(()) by default, supplying an optional no-op notification; SerializeMap::serialize_entry writes actual data.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: TaggedContentVisitor reads special tag-or-content keys, rejects duplicate tags, buffers all other content and rejects an absent tag at the end. Flattened enum lookup uses a different variant-name key convention. This shares internal-enum family f0015.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: TaggedContentVisitor sequence handling requires its first element as tag, wraps the remainder in SeqAccessDeserializer and buffers it with ContentVisitor. Map handling searches named keys instead. This shares f0015.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: UntaggedUnitVisitor accepts unit or none; the internal-tag unit visitor consumes every extra map entry as IgnoredAny pairs. TaggedContentVisitor buffers data instead of discarding it.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: Adjacent-enum generation selects strict or permissive key visitors from deny_unknown_fields; the strict byte callback emits invalid_value for an unrelated key while the permissive callback returns Other.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: Adjacent-enum missing-content generation accepts unit variants, invokes the private missing_field helper for ordinary non-custom newtypes and preserves errors for other shapes; the helper can provide None for Option.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: Derived sequence field generation counts only non-skipped fields, synthesizes skipped values without reads, and increments index_in_seq only for a consumed input position. The missing-length helper receives that index rather than deciding it. This shares f0075.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: Externally tagged generation uses all(skip_deserializing), which also holds for empty enums, and maps the EnumAccess result through an impossible success match; untagged retries use a separate buffered strategy.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: with_self_bound appends a WherePredicate with bounded_ty=type_of_item(cont), targeting the complete container type; field traversal instead discovers individual generic parameters.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: with_lifetime_bound prepends the supplied lifetime, adds it to existing lifetime/type bounds and preserves const parameters while cloning remaining generic metadata.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: VecAttr::insert records the second value token once; at_most_one reports that duplicate and returns None for multiple values, unlike immediate scalar Attr duplicate handling. This shares f0040.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: unraw strips the r# prefix from the identifier spelling and constructs the new Ident with its original span; Name::from copies the spelling and span without stripping.

rows.author: /root/p8_corpus_closeout
rows.source_read_conclusion: struct_from_ast classifies named fields as Struct, exactly one unnamed field as Newtype, every other unnamed count including zero as Tuple, and unit syntax as Unit. The final facet preserves the empty-tuple/unit distinction. Later serialization may override a skipped newtype to Unit; this shares family f0108.
